What this website collects

This website has no forms, accounts, analytics, advertising or tracking tools, and it sets no cookies. We do not collect personal data through it directly. Our hosting provider () may process technical data such as your IP address in server logs to deliver the page and keep it secure.

If you contact or book with us

If you call or write to us, we use your contact details and message to reply (our legitimate interest, or steps you ask us to take before a booking). If you book, we process your booking and guest details to provide your stay (contract) and to meet legal duties such as guest registration and accounting records (legal obligation). We keep data only as long as needed for these purposes or as the law requires.

Bookings through Booking.com

Reservations are made on Booking.com, which handles payment and booking details under its own privacy policy. We receive the details we need to host you.

Links to other sites

Links to Booking.com and Google Maps take you to those services. Their own privacy and cookie practices apply once you leave this website.

Who we share data with

Only service providers that help us run the hotel and website, Booking.com for reservations, and public authorities where the law requires.

Your rights

Under the Law on Personal Data Protection of North Macedonia (Official Gazette 42/2020) you can ask to access, correct, delete or restrict your data, object to its use, request portability, and withdraw consent at any time.
